description:
Get the full grounded record for one app by name: description, category, pricing (including the vendor's own currency, plans and limits), feature list, platforms, and open-source/self-hosting status.

Every field comes from the product's own website. Fields the site never stated are reported as "not stated" rather than guessed or defaulted; "not stated" does not mean the capability is absent.

Each app's name in the results is a link that resolves to the vendor's own site.
name: get_app
title: Get app details
